raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) sends amount strings with a leading '$' (e.g. '$75.13'), while other batches send plain numbers. All rows are currency USD, so the '$' is only a formatting change and makes the DECIMAL cast in silver_transactions fail. Removing the '$' and any thousands separators before the cast gives the intended values without changing their meaning.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(replace(trim(CAST(amount AS VARCHAR)), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
